# Xaply

> Xaply is a free URL shortener and one of the fastest redirect URL shorteners. Short links run on Cloudflare's edge (sub-10ms), with real-time analytics, and a URL shortener for business teams.

Xaply is a free URL shortener for creators, marketers, founders, and companies. Turn long URLs into short links at `go.xaply.in`, track clicks with geo and device analytics, and manage links from the dashboard at `xaply.in`. Upgrade to Business for team seats, extra workspaces, webhooks, and 3-year analytics.

## Canonical site

- Website: https://xaply.in
- Short-link domain: https://go.xaply.in
- Sign up (free URL shortener): https://xaply.in/sign-up

## Product summary

- Custom or random short slugs
- Fastest redirects on Cloudflare's edge (`go.xaply.in`)
- Real-time click analytics (countries, cities, devices, browsers, referrers)
- QR codes generated in the browser
- Password-protected links
- Link expiry by date or max clicks
- Free URL shortener: 50 active links, 5,000 tracked clicks/month, 7-day analytics history. No credit card.
- Pro: 500 active links, 50,000 tracked clicks/month, up to 1 year analytics history
- URL shortener for business: unlimited links, 1,000,000 tracked clicks/month, 3-year analytics, 50 team seats, up to 30 owned workspaces, webhooks, priority support

## Public pages for indexing

- https://xaply.in: what is Xaply, features, pricing (Free / Pro / Business), FAQ
- https://xaply.in/sign-up: create a free account
- https://xaply.in/contact: support
- https://xaply.in/privacy: privacy policy
- https://xaply.in/terms: terms of service

## Pages not intended for indexing

- /dashboard, /analytics, /workspaces, /settings, /admin: authenticated app areas
- /sign-in, /forgot-password, /reset-password, /verify-email: account utilities
- /api/*: application APIs

## Technology

- Built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, and Queues
- Dashboard: Next.js on Cloudflare
- Auth: Better Auth (email, Google, GitHub)

## FAQ

See the full FAQ on https://xaply.in#faq

Common questions:
- What is Xaply? A free URL shortener with the fastest Cloudflare redirects, analytics, and a Business plan for teams.
- Is Xaply free? Yes. The free plan has generous limits and no credit card required.
- Is Xaply a URL shortener for business? Yes. Business includes 50 seats, extra workspaces, webhooks, 1M visits/month, and 3-year analytics.
- What analytics are included? Clicks over time, top links, countries, cities, devices, browsers, OS, referrers.
- Where do redirects happen? On Cloudflare's edge via `go.xaply.in` for low latency worldwide.
